summary: Frontend regression of redesigned Intl Shipments workspace (list + inspector). Empty-creds login -> Intl Shipments loads with 4 active shipments; inspector auto-populates. Selecting IS-0011 shows SASAtrend + 'Awaiting prepayment' + CTA 'Mark prepaid'; is-insp-advance -> Prepaid status in row & inspector, CTA becomes 'Mark shipped'. is-insp-open opens intl-shipment-detail; is-back returns. Double-click IS-0012 opens detail. Filters: is-stage-shipped=1 row, is-kpi-released=0 (IS-0011 advanced), is-kpi-all resets to 3, is-attn-group-message=2 rows, is-search 'SASA'=1 row, is-clear-filters restores 3, customer MultiSelect toggle opens with 3 options, is-empty shown when no match, footer totals update (3 shipments / 2,670 units / $24,099 SO / $9,822.75 PO). Messages: is-attn-reply-IS-0012 opens is-chat + is-back; is-attn-ignore-IS-0010 decrements Needs reply 2->1. is-tab-orders shows is-open-orders and hides shipment toolbar filters; back restores search. New Shipment create flow creates IS-0013 and opens detail. is-factories drawer renders 3 factories. Responsive: 0 horizontal overflow at 1920x900 / 1280x800 / 390x844. 0 console errors, 0 page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 445 lines; Detail component (~180 lines) should be extracted to its own file for readability/maintainability.
useMemo for rows lists 'ignored' state only via eslint-disable; add ignored explicitly to deps to avoid stale-closure risk.
advanceOne toast uses STATUS_LABEL directly (fine), but detail Detail.advance() emits 'Released to factory' only for prepaid; consider consistent labelling with list advance.

Inspector shows 'Mark prepaid' when status is 'prepayment' but the KPI is labelled 'payment due' while data-testid is 'is-kpi-released' — the testid semantics mismatch label ('released'/'payment due').
Customer MultiSelect toggle test-id is 'is-filter-customer-toggle' (present) but review request also references generic 'is-filter-customer' — verified working.
seed_data_creation: IS-0013 created transiently during New Shipment flow (client-only state)
context_for_next_testing_agent: New list+inspector workspace works end-to-end. Advancing IS-0011 in inspector removes it from is-kpi-released count. Needs reply chip disables when count=0. MultiSelect toggle testid is 'is-filter-{customer|factory}-toggle' with options 'is-filter-customer-opt-*'. is-clear-filters only rendered when a filter is applied. On <=narrow viewports, inspector stacks under the list (no overflow). All flows PASS.
